# Reference data sources

<!-- Generated by scripts/fetch.mjs. Do not edit: re-run the script (README.md). -->

This file records where every row of [`data/`](data/) comes from: the snapshot of 2026-10-13 (UTC), built by [`scripts/fetch.mjs`](scripts/fetch.mjs) as [ADR-0024](../../docs/mvp/adr/0024-reference-data-sources-and-loader.md) describes. `node scripts/fetch.mjs --check` verifies the files below against it offline.

## Attribution

OpenTravelData is licensed under CC BY 4.0, which requires attribution. The storefront's legal page and the OTA admin's About page carry this line (ADR-0024):

> Contains data from OpenTravelData (CC BY 4.0)

The files in `data/` are adapted from the sources below: filtered to rows with an IATA code, one row per code, normalised to the columns of [`reference.sql`](../../docs/velexis-sdk/db/reference.sql) (README.md, "Mapping"). Unicode CLDR data is used under the Unicode License v3; its notice is reproduced at the end.

## Licences

- **OpenTravelData**: [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), as stated under "Licensing" in the project README (re-checked by the script on the retrieval date). Project: <https://github.com/opentraveldata/opentraveldata>.
- **Unicode CLDR**: [Unicode License v3](https://www.unicode.org/license.txt) (`LICENSE` of cldr-json `48.2.0`, re-checked on the retrieval date). Project: <https://cldr.unicode.org>.
- **IANA time zone names** come through CLDR; the offsets are computed locally with `Intl` (tzdata is public domain).

## Notes of this snapshot

- 12 airports keep city_code empty, OPTD names no served city that is a city: AFP, AMI, CAS, GAK, GXA, HNK, JRS, PYX, REP, UQE, ZPK, ZRF
- 21 airports lose an ICAO code that a more relevant airport keeps (UNIQUE): ALY (HEAX stays with HBE), CIB (KAVX stays with AVX), COX (MYAK stays with TZN), CSJ (KCSG stays with CSG), DAE (VEDZ stays with DEP), DJT (KDJT stays with PBI), DNM (YSHK stays with MJK), DTS (KDTS stays with DSI), EAP (LFSB stays with BSL), FRU (UCFM stays with BSZ), KIV (LUKK stays with RMO), MLH (LFSB stays with BSL), NOH (KNBU stays with NBU), NSF (KADW stays with ADW), PUM (WAWP stays with KXB), QCN (SSCN stays with CEL), SRI (WALS stays with AAP), SUZ (AYHG stays with HEO), SXF (EDDB stays with BER), TPO (PALJ stays with PTA), TSE (UACC stays with NQZ)
- 21 airlines keep country_code empty, their bases lie in several countries: 3R (BQ, CW), 5X (DE, HK, US), 9S (DE, US), 9W (IN, NL), D0 (GB, US), E4 (ES, GR, PL), HS (FR, MC), K6 (KH, VN), KP (CM, TG), LI (AG, BB, TT), LV (AT, ES, FR), M6 (TT, US), N9 (NO, SE), OE (AT, DE), PO (KR, US), SI (GG, JE), TJ (BL, KN, PR, US), V7 (ES, FR, IT), VA (AU, NZ), W3 (GH, NG), XQ (DE, TR)
- 11 airlines lose an ICAO code that a more relevant airline keeps (UNIQUE): BH (BHA stays with U4), BU (FPY stays with OG), CC (OMT stays with H5), EA (EAL stays with 2D), F7 (DWT stays with 0D), H4 (HLI stays with HS), LZ (SWU stays with BQ), QI (CIM stays with QA), SP (RZO stays with S4), U3 (AIA stays with 8R), X8 (DAP stays with V5)
- 19 aircraft keep body_type empty, the source gives no type: ACD, ALM, AMD, AN2, BEC, CL4, CNA, CV6, CVF, CVR, DF3, DHB, DHO, L49, LOM, ND2, PAG, SHB, VCV
